name: cpp-repl
description: cpp-repl, a C++ REPL on top of clang-repl, and the skills that run C++ in it and add libraries to it.

plugins.name: cpp-repl
plugins.description: Run C++ without a build in cpp-repl; add a C++ library to it (headers, shared libraries, printers, a checked example), make a type print, or contribute a built-in profile.
